text: Particles P of mass 0.4 kg and Q of mass 0.5 kg are free to move on a smooth horizontal plane. P and
Q are moving directly towards each other with speeds 2.5 m s and 1.5 m s respectively. After P
and Q collide, the speed of Q is twice the speed of P.
Find the two possible values of the speed of P after the collision. [4]

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
It is given that as the car and trailer descend the hill, the engine of the car does 150 000 J of work,
and there are no resistance forces.
